# netatmo-weather-mcp

> Netatmo Weather Station MCP Server — AI-powered weather monitoring with sampling and predictive analytics.

## Key Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — Full tool reference, configuration, and architecture
- [README.md](README.md) — User-facing documentation
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — Installation and setup
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — Release history

## Quick Start

```powershell
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your Netatmo credentials
just serve
```

## Core Tools

- `weather_station_management` — List, get info, or check status of Netatmo stations
- `weather_data_operations` — Current, historical, sample, or analyze weather data
- `ai_weather_sampling` — Iterative, predictive, or anomaly AI sampling
- `weather_prediction_engine` — Short-term forecast, trend analysis, anomaly detection

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Webapp frontend | 10822 |
| Webapp backend | 10823 |

## Data Storage

No local database. All data fetched live from Netatmo cloud API. In-memory cache only (300s TTL).

## Monitoring

Prometheus metrics on port 9091, structured logging via structlog.
